decision: Permit required decorative ReactElement content named icon only for IconButton, named separately by required label. No other component gains permission.

evidence.channel: Interactive owner choice forwarded in the parent task
evidence.question: Approve an IconButton-only semantic exception for its required icon prop?
evidence.interpretation: Assistant record of forwarded explicit interactive owner selection, not native, signed, independent or per-payload serialized review. Hashes bind recorded content, not proof of consent. Toggle and Button approvals are separate and are not authority for this amendment.

limits: Only IconButton.icon: required decorative ReactElement, named separately by required label.
All other components retain the previous leading-icon restrictions. No general icon-only, trailing-icon or interactive-icon permission.
The exceptions array only represents alternative prop names; this same-name semantic exception uses a bounded semantic amendment.
Historical receipts and hashes remain immutable. Full-contract approval and the separately parent-approved bounded implementation plan remain distinct.

before.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology.
before.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text.
before.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning.

after.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. IconButton alone requires one decorative ReactElement icon, named separately by its required label.
after.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. IconButton alone also permits required decorative icon-only content with a separate required label.
after.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. The icon-only exclusion has one exception: IconButton.icon with required label; no other component gains icon-only permission.

semanticAmendments.boundary: IconButton only. Canonical name, aliases, exceptions and status are unchanged. Button and Toggle grants must remain independently recoverable; no global widening.
